body:
Founder real-time (2026-09-12): "lets start adding textures to shankpit have the compile like
generate the textures at compile for now... its going to bring us from like 1982 graphics to
1999 graphics."

draw_terrain (ground) and draw_map (walls) were pure flat-shaded per-vertex-color geometry, no
texture at all. Added two new seamlessly-tileable procedural generators to packages/render/
proc_tex.c (ground: banded fbm-noise stone/dirt; walls: real running-bond brick pattern), via a
new tileable noise variant that wraps its lattice at the texture's own period for seamless
GL_REPEAT tiling. Generated once at startup, bound underneath the existing per-vertex lighting/
fog glColor3f calls (GL_MODULATE tint on top, unchanged behavior). Live-verified: built
bin/shank_lobby, ran headless under Xvfb, screenshotted in-game -- real tiled texture detail
visible on floor and walls, no crash, no new warnings.

Real, honest scope note: procedural placeholder only, per the founder's own "for now" framing.
Real photo-sourced textures are separate future work; other draw_* functions (player models,
vehicles, UI) still flat-colored.

SHANKPIT commit 2d03736.
